comment: Answer key for the root-cause fixture. The symptom (a failing quote test) sits three modules away from the cause (to_cents truncates instead of rounding half up), the commit that made it visible is a TEST-DATA change, and the most suspicious-looking recent commit — a zone-lookup cache — is innocent. Two more sites carry the same truncation with no test at all. Scored on state.json like every other eval; a run that names the cache or the test change as the cause has told a plausible story instead of finding the defect.

terms_any: the cache is the root cause
root cause is the test change
rows.note: Amended 2026-09-07: `root cause: the test` alone matched the report renderer's own "- Root cause: <mechanism>" line of an unrelated finding whose mechanism began "the test dependency (pytest) is declared nowhere" — a run that had cleared the decoy read as blaming it (scorer FP #6, found on the 0.84.0 payment). The phrase now needs the test *change* or the test *data* named.

Added 2026-09-03 with the v0.74.0 contract clause it scores. Terms are taken from the clause, not from any run's phrasing. First draft also accepted the bare string `__pycache__` and a control run earned the row for the sentence 'clean apart from __pycache__' — naming the directory while reporting the checkout untouched is housekeeping, not isolation. As scored now: 3 of 3 treatment runs earn it, 0 of 4 byte-identical control runs on the v0.73.0 prompt do. The row exists because VERDICT-F-52 established that no fixture could tell one version of this contract from another.

Added 2026-09-07 with 0.84.0 (H-2's one open concern): filing findings one at a time must not turn 'three sites, one root cause' into three findings. Exactly one open finding owns the truncation class (its root_cause.class.sites names the other sites) and no other finding cites one of those sites as its own defect — `class_conflicts`, the rule finalize refuses on. Sites are read by `path:line` reference into the two files, both required — a test named `test_invoice_renders_lines` in another finding's class is not a site in invoice.py (the first draft counted it, and read a legitimate second finding as a split).

Added 2026-09-07 with 0.84.0 (H-2): a NEW finding carries `filed_at` only when it was written as findings/<ID>.json — proven and filed in the moment, not composed at the end. n/a on a state an older harness measured.

Added 2026-09-07 with 0.84.0: at least 80% of the `path:line` references in the evidence resolve to a line in the repository (0.83.0's anchors). Scores evidence that names real lines; the boltons acceptance run measured 13 of 69 unresolvable.
